Risk_Description: Sudden demand spike due to unplanned event (cricket final, festival)
Mitigation_Strategy: Maintain 15% buffer stock for top SKUs during high-risk periods

Risk_Description: Demand forecast error exceeding 20% for slow-moving SKUs
Mitigation_Strategy: Switch to weekly rolling forecast; review MAPE monthly

Risk_Description: Monsoon season demand trough deeper than expected
Mitigation_Strategy: Pre-negotiate flexible order quantities with distributors

Risk_Description: Key malt supplier disruption due to crop failure or logistics issue
Mitigation_Strategy: Dual-source malt from at least 2 approved suppliers

Risk_Description: Packaging material shortage (cans, bottles) from single vendor
Mitigation_Strategy: Maintain 30-day packaging buffer; qualify alternate vendor

Risk_Description: Supplier quality failure causing batch rejection
Mitigation_Strategy: 100% incoming quality check; supplier scorecard monitoring

Risk_Description: Fuel price spike increasing freight cost by 15%+
Mitigation_Strategy: Hedge freight contracts quarterly; shift volume to rail

Risk_Description: Major road/highway blockage disrupting North-South corridor
Mitigation_Strategy: Pre-identify alternate routes; maintain regional safety stock

Risk_Description: Fleet breakdown during peak season (Oct-Dec)
Mitigation_Strategy: Preventive maintenance schedule; tie-up with backup fleet vendors

Risk_Description: Driver shortage during festive season
Mitigation_Strategy: Retain drivers with festive bonus; 3PL backup agreements

Risk_Description: Cold chain temperature breach during summer months
Mitigation_Strategy: Real-time IoT temperature monitoring; SLA with cold chain vendors

Risk_Description: Port/rail strike disrupting inter-city movement
Mitigation_Strategy: Emergency road freight plan; 15-day buffer stock at key hubs

Risk_Description: Stockout of premium SKU during Diwali/New Year
Mitigation_Strategy: EOQ-based pre-season build with safety stock buffer

Risk_Description: Expiry/quality degradation of slow-moving SKU in warehouse
Mitigation_Strategy: FEFO (First Expiry First Out) picking policy; monthly SKU audit

Risk_Description: Overstocking due to over-forecast causing high holding cost
Mitigation_Strategy: Cap safety stock at 30 days; trigger liquidation at 45 days

Risk_Description: Top distributor (Grade A) losing license or exiting market
Mitigation_Strategy: Identify and develop 2nd-tier distributors in each zone

Risk_Description: Distributor financial distress causing order default
Mitigation_Strategy: Monthly credit monitoring; cap credit limit at 30-day value

Risk_Description: Distributor selling competitor products over company products
Mitigation_Strategy: Exclusive zone agreements; volume-linked incentive scheme

Risk_Description: State government changing alcohol distribution regulations
Mitigation_Strategy: Legal monitoring team; compliance buffer in business plan

Risk_Description: GST rate change on beverages affecting margins
Mitigation_Strategy: Build 5% margin buffer; pass-through clause in distributor contracts

Risk_Description: Natural disaster (flood/cyclone) disrupting East/South India hub
Mitigation_Strategy: Geo-distributed hub strategy; disaster recovery plan

Risk_Description: Counterfeit product flooding market in a region
Mitigation_Strategy: Track-and-trace barcoding; rapid market audit protocol

Risk_Description: WMS (Warehouse Mgmt System) downtime during peak dispatch
Mitigation_Strategy: Manual backup SOP; daily data backup; vendor SLA < 2 hr response

Risk_Description: GPS tracker failure on cold chain vehicles
Mitigation_Strategy: Dual-device installation; driver check-in protocol every 2 hours
